author: codex
task: Add sequential invoice issuance per company. Export `issueInvoice(store: InvoiceStore, companyId: string, invoiceId: string): Promise<Invoice>` from `src/service.ts`, assigning a number and returning the issued invoice. Use the existing exported `InvoiceError` for invalid issuance requests; storage errors may propagate.

requirements.text: Allocate after all existing company numbers, including void records; companies have independent sequences.
Concurrent issuance is unique and repeated issuance is idempotent.
A failed save leaves the invoice draft and does not consume a number.
Reject foreign and void invoices with InvoiceError without changing them.
Draft validation, amount calculations and labels retain their existing behavior.
